ApiNamedQuery.body2: SELECT Id, Name, LDGCRM_Email__c, LDGCRM_External_ID__c, LDGCRM_P3_Partner_Portal_Team_Name__c, LDGCRM_P3_Team_UUID__c, LGDCRM_P3_Partner_Portal_Admin__c, LDGCRM_contact__r.Name, LDGCRM_Application__r.Name, LastModifiedDate FROM LDGCRM_Application_Contact__c WHERE LastModifiedDate >= :modifiedsince ORDER BY LastModifiedDate DESC
ApiNamedQuery.description: Login.gov Partnership Portal Integration. Application Contacts changed at or after an instant, for incremental sync. The datetime literal needs an offset and no fractional seconds.

apiNamedQueryParameters.description: Return rows whose LastModifiedDate is at or after this instant.
